summary: First-finish smoke test of Notarium MVP (backend + frontend). Admin login, dashboard stats, journal CRUD with signature pad, signer auto-creation, PDF export, doc types, settings persistence, sidebar navigation, and logout all work end-to-end.
passed: POST /api/auth/login with seeded admin returns 200 and sets httpOnly cookies
GET /api/auth/me returns admin profile with role=admin
GET /api/document-types returns 8 seeded types (Affidavit, Deed, Living Will, Loan Document, ...)
POST /api/entries creates entry (requires entry_date) and auto-creates client in /api/clients when signer not present
Frontend login → dashboard renders with 4 stat cards (entries, revenue, signers, avg fee) and both charts
Journal: New Entry dialog fills, signature canvas draw captured, save persists and entry visible in list
Journal search filters by signer name (Jane Tester)
Signers page auto-shows the signer created from journal entry
Document Types page loads with add input
Settings: saving commission number shows 'Commission details saved' toast and value reflects on Dashboard header on refresh
Sidebar nav (nav-dashboard, nav-journal, nav-clients, nav-doctypes, nav-settings) all route correctly
Logout returns to /login and route is protected
notes: Route for dashboard is '/' (not '/dashboard') — matches App.js routing. Not a bug.
Recharts logs a benign width(-1)/height(-1) warning on initial mount before container measures; charts still render correctly.
Signers sidebar item test-id is 'nav-clients' (label 'Signers') — consistent with request.
